news.headline: Brent crude tops $96/bbl (+2.5%) after Houthis claim first direct attacks on Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea
news.summary: Published Jul 23, 2026 (~10:40 IST / ~10:10 PKT): Brent crude rose 2.5% (+$2.42) to above $96/bbl (TradingEconomics quoted $96.65, +2.75% on the day, +2.66% on the month), building on the prior session's six-week high; WTI rose about 2% (+$1.84) to near $88/bbl. Driver: Iran-backed Houthi militants claimed responsibility for missile-and-drone strikes on two Saudi Arabian oil tankers (named Encelia and Layla) in the Red Sea, alleging the vessels breached a blockade the group had imposed; UK Maritime Trade Operations confirmed a commercial vessel was struck by a projectile off Saudi Arabia's coast, causing an onboard fire - described by analysts as the first direct attacks on oil tankers operating in the Red Sea, a major escalation. Separately, President Trump was quoted stating Iran is 'not ready for deal, but will be soon.' Third consecutive session of sharp oil-price escalation (following the $90.19 read on Jul 20 and $92.71 read on Jul 22, both already logged) - sharp commodity move per desk news-impact criteria (Rule 10), with direct read-through for Pakistan's OMC (PSO), refiners (ATRL, NRL, PRL), E&P names (MARI, OGDC, PPL), gas utilities (SNGP, SSGC) and HUBC, plus renewed inflation/import-bill and current-account pressure; escalation flagged.

news.summary: Published Jul 23, 2026 11:17am PKT, corroborated by a same-day GlobeNewswire release: Nestle S.A. (Nestle Pakistan's majority shareholder) and Platinum Equity announced a proposed 50/50 global joint venture, Peranel, combining Nestle's waters and premium-beverages business (30+ brands incl. S.Pellegrino, Perrier, Nestle Pure Life, across 120 countries, led by CEO designate Muriel Lienau from Paris) - separately reported elsewhere as a transaction valuing Peranel at $5.6bn. Nestle's water operations in Pakistan are included in the global business covered by the proposed transaction; the deal is expected to close in H1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and finalisation of corporate procedures. At this stage, Nestle Pakistan Limited (PSX: NESTLE) 'intends only to incorporate a local entity,' with the company stating further disclosures will follow if material developments occur - no financial terms specific to the Pakistan business, no NESTLE-level stake or valuation figure disclosed in the sources reviewed. Logged as impact 3 (notable corporate development, effect on NESTLE's own financials not yet quantified) pending further disclosure.

news.headline: Pakistan business confidence recovers, future outlook turns positive - Gallup survey
news.summary: Published Jul 23, 2026 11:26am PKT: Gallup Pakistan's Business Confidence Index, surveying 527 businesses across 40 districts/cities in all four provinces plus AJK and Malakand (survey period July 2-7, 2026) across manufacturing, services, construction, financial services and wholesale/retail trade, found current-business-conditions score improved to -10% (from -19% in Q1 2026) and future-business-conditions score rose to +12%; the direction-of-country score improved to -20%. Gallup executive director Bilal I. Gilani quoted: 'There is no doubt there is recovery in business confidence in the country; however, indicators remain in the negative despite this recovery.' 72% of businesses reported power outages and 34% cited inflation as their primary concern requiring government intervention. Background macro sentiment survey, no PSX-ticker-level figures disclosed - logged as impact 2 (minor/background) consistent with prior confidence-survey items in this newslog.

news.headline: Brent crude tops $100/bbl for first time since May, still up ~12-14.6% for the week amid Red Sea blockade fears
news.summary: Brent settled above $100/bbl in Thursday's (Jul 23) session for the first time since May per Express Tribune; on Friday (Jul 24) Brent eased to $98.87/bbl, down $1.82 (-1.81%) on the day but still up 12% for the week, WTI at $90.59/bbl, down $1.60 (-1.74%) but up 9.7% for the week (Express Tribune, published Jul 24, 2026). A separate wire read cited by Business Recorder's headline ('Brent hovers above $100/bbl, set for weekly rise on Middle East escalation') and corroborated by Bloomberg had Brent advancing 37 cents (+0.37%) to $101.06/bbl, on course for a 14.6% weekly advance. Driver: Iran-aligned Houthi militants' claimed strikes on two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea, closure threats to the Bab el-Mandeb strait and a Houthi naval blockade threat against Saudi Arabia, plus Kazakhstan suspending crude exports via the Caspian Pipeline Consortium terminal after drone attacks. PVM Oil Associates analyst John Evans quoted (Express Tribune): 'Major hubs of oil production or supply routes are surrounded by war. The short-term outlook is bullish.' JPMorgan analysts projected 'each additional month of disruption to oil supply would add around $7 to $8 a barrel to Brent,' potentially reaching $114/barrel if disruptions extend three months. Fourth consecutive session of sharp oil-price escalation (following $90.19 on Jul 20, $92.71 on Jul 22, $96.65 on Jul 23, all previously logged) - sharp commodity move per desk news-impact criteria (Rule 10), direct read-through for PSO, ATRL, NRL, PRL, MARI, OGDC, PPL, HUBC, SNGP, SSGC plus renewed inflation/import-bill/current-account pressure economy-wide; escalation flagged.

news.headline: Volatility at PSX, KSE-100 closes week lower
news.summary: Weekend wrap-up adding new detail to Friday's confirmed close already logged this cycle (KSE-100 171,021.20, -718.24/-718.25 pts, -0.42%): Business Recorder reports the session swung from an intraday low of 169,512.88 to a high of 172,718.66 before late profit-taking eroded the rally; index-heavy losers UBL, NBP, Systems Limited (SYS), HBL and FFC cumulatively cut about 436 points from the index. On a weekly basis the KSE-100 declined 2.7% (Business Recorder) / 2.72% (Express Tribune) WoW, attributed to 'continued escalation in tensions between the US and Iran' pushing crude oil prices higher and dampening investor sentiment. Express Tribune's read of the same Friday session adds breadth not previously logged (186 advancing, 270 declining, 36 unchanged) and stock-level detail: top gainers Adamjee Insurance (AICL) +6.38%, TRG Pakistan (TRG) +3.66%, Meezan Bank (MEBL) +0.3%; top losers NBP -2.18%, Systems Limited (SYS) -1.66%, UBL -1.2%; volume leader Cnergyico Pk (CNERGY) at 59.33m shares. Arif Habib Limited (AHL) quoted: the index 'has now fallen 10% from its July peak and is once again testing its 200-day moving average' - a bearish technical read not previously captured. Brent crude cited around $100/bbl on the same US-Iran/Red Sea escalation already logged this cycle; both outlets note markets are now looking ahead to the SBP's Monetary Policy Committee decision due July 27, 2026, widely expected (per the Topline Securities poll already logged) to hold the policy rate at 11.5% given the geopolitical and oil-price backdrop. No new price level beyond the already-logged 171,021.20 confirmed close; logged as impact 3 for the weekly-decline framing and the new AHL technical caution (200-day moving average test), which had not been captured in the prior daily-close entry.
news.headline_ur: PSX میں اتار چڑھاؤ، KSE-100 ہفتہ نچلی سطح پر بند ہوا
news.summary_ur: جمعہ کے پہلے سے درج تصدیق شدہ کلوز (KSE-100 171,021.20، -718.24/-718.25 پوائنٹس، -0.42%) میں نئی تفصیل شامل کرنے والا ویک اینڈ خلاصہ: بزنس ریکارڈر کے مطابق سیشن انٹرا ڈے کم ترین سطح 169,512.88 سے بلند ترین سطح 172,718.66 تک گیا، مگر آخر میں منافع کی وصولی نے ریلی کو کمزور کر دیا؛ انڈیکس کے بڑے حصص میں نقصان اٹھانے والے UBL، NBP، Systems Limited (SYS)، HBL اور FFC نے مجموعی طور پر انڈیکس سے تقریباً 436 پوائنٹس کم کیے۔ ہفتہ وار بنیاد پر KSE-100 میں 2.7% (بزنس ریکارڈر) / 2.72% (ایکسپریس ٹریبیون) کی کمی ہوئی، جس کی وجہ 'امریکہ اور ایران کے درمیان کشیدگی میں مسلسل اضافہ' بتائی گئی جس نے خام تیل کی قیمتیں بڑھائیں اور سرمایہ کاروں کے جذبات کو متاثر کیا۔ ایکسپریس ٹریبیون کی اسی جمعہ سیشن کی رپورٹ نے پہلے درج نہ کی گئی بریڈتھ شامل کی (186 بڑھنے والے، 270 گرنے والے، 36 غیر تبدیل شدہ) اور اسٹاک کی سطح کی تفصیل: سب سے زیادہ فائدہ اٹھانے والے Adamjee Insurance (AICL) +6.38%، TRG Pakistan (TRG) +3.66%، Meezan Bank (MEBL) +0.3%؛ سب سے زیادہ نقصان اٹھانے والے NBP -2.18%، Systems Limited (SYS) -1.66%، UBL -1.2%؛ حجم میں سب سے آگے Cnergyico Pk (CNERGY) 59.33m شیئرز کے ساتھ۔ Arif Habib Limited (AHL) کا حوالہ: انڈیکس 'اپنی جولائی کی چوٹی سے اب تک 10% گر چکا ہے اور ایک بار پھر اپنی 200-دن کی موونگ ایوریج کو ٹیسٹ کر رہا ہے' — ایک مندی کا تکنیکی نکتہ جو پہلے درج نہیں کیا گیا تھا۔ برینٹ کروڈ کا حوالہ اسی امریکہ-ایران/بحیرہ احمر کی کشیدگی کے تناظر میں تقریباً $100/bbl دیا گیا جو اس سائیکل میں پہلے ہی درج ہو چکا ہے؛ دونوں ادارے نوٹ کرتے ہیں کہ مارکیٹس اب SBP کی مانیٹری پالیسی کمیٹی کے 27 جولائی 2026 کو متوقع فیصلے کی جانب دیکھ رہی ہیں، جس کے بارے میں (پہلے سے درج Topline Securities سروے کے مطابق) وسیع پیمانے پر توقع ہے کہ جغرافیائی و سیاسی اور تیل کی قیمتوں کے پس منظر میں پالیسی ریٹ 11.5% پر برقرار رکھا جائے گا۔ پہلے سے درج 171,021.20 کے تصدیق شدہ کلوز کے علاوہ کوئی نئی قیمت کی سطح نہیں؛ ہفتہ وار کمی کے فریم ورک اور نئے AHL تکنیکی احتیاطی نکتے (200-دن موونگ ایوریج ٹیسٹ) کے لیے امپیکٹ 3 کے طور پر درج کیا گیا، جو پچھلی روزانہ کلوز کی انٹری میں شامل نہیں تھا۔
